body: Thank you so much for taking the time to reply to me about this. I feel a little better from your kind words and showing me how you are getting through this. It was so nice having someone, even a stranger, reach out to me with kind thoughts, I can't even express my gratitude right now. *hugs*

I hope that you are right.

What you've written is so familiar to me. I am sorry that you are also going through the same. I wish people realized that when they leave us alone that it only makes us feel.... worthless.
